Nitrox_ModSync_BlockingIntro: These problems can't be fixed by downloading the host's mods:
Nitrox_ModSync_Cancelled: The download was paused. Already downloaded files are kept and the download continues where it stopped.
Nitrox_ModSync_DownloadExplanation: Nitrod can download {SIZE} directly from the host. Every file is verified (SHA-256) and installed the next time you start the game from the Nitrod launcher. Files it replaces are backed up, and you can undo the install in the launcher under Mods.
Nitrox_ModSync_DownloadsDisabled: The host doesn't allow downloads. Install the listed mods yourself (same versions), then join again.
Nitrox_ModSync_Failed: The mods could not be downloaded. Nothing was installed.
Nitrox_ModSync_Intro: {SERVER} plays with mods you don't have in the same version:
Nitrox_ModSync_NativeWarning: These files contain code that can't be inspected like regular mod DLLs. Only continue if you trust this host and these mods. Nitrod never runs downloaded files itself.
Nitrox_ModSync_Restart:
All files were downloaded and verified. Subnautica has to restart to load them:

1. Quit the game.
2. Press Play in the Nitrod launcher. It installs the mods before the game starts.
3. Join the server again.
